# Security Policy

The canonical supported-version, scope, response-time, and disclosure policy
is maintained in [`../SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md). This file exists so
GitHub's Security tab discovers that single policy instead of maintaining a
second, potentially conflicting copy.

Do not open a public issue for an exploitable vulnerability. Use
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/1oT/YggdraSIM/security/advisories/new)
or the alternative private channel documented in the canonical policy.

Non-exploitable hardening findings may use the repository's Security report
issue form and remain subject to [`SECURITY_CONTROLS.md`](SECURITY_CONTROLS.md).
